description: Volume Data Jan- May 2013 for Dublin City, from Traffic Department's SCATS System DCC is a dataset listed in Ireland national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Dublin City Council. Volume data across Dublin City, from DCC s SCATS system, in csv format. The volume data is aggregated over 5 minute intervals for each approach into an instrumented intersection. There are separate files for each region (CCITY, SCITY, NCITY, WCITY) and for each day. See documentation provided in each zip archive for details. Coverage: Dublin City Council. The portal files it under the publisher Dublin City Council. Its tags are Public, Transport, Transport and Infrastructure, traffic, traffic-counts. It offers 4 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ie-portal.
